title: Idle inhibitor
description: The idle_inhibitor module can inhibit the idle behavior such as screen blanking, locking, and screensaver, also known as "presentation mode".

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how the state should be displayed.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-icons.label: Icons
format-icons.doc: Based on the current state, the corresponding icon gets selected.
format-icons.description: The icons used for {icon}. When it is a list, the first icon is used for the lowest level and the last one for the highest.

rotate.label: Rotation
rotate.doc: Positive value to rotate the text label (in 90 degree increments).
rotate.description: Rotate the text. Mostly useful on vertical bars.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: The maximum length in character the module should display.
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.

min-length.label: Minimum length
min-length.doc: The minimum length in characters the module should accept.
min-length.description: Keep the module at least this wide, so the bar doesn't jump around when the text changes.

align.label: Text position
align.doc: The alignment of the label within the module, where 0 is left-aligned and 1 is right-aligned. If the module is rotated, it will follow the flow of the text.
align.description: Where the text sits inside the module: 0 is left, 0.5 is center, 1 is right.

justify.label: Line alignment
justify.doc: The alignment of the text within the module's label, allowing options 'left', 'right', or 'center' to define the positioning.
justify.description: How lines are aligned when the text has more than one line.

on-click.label: Left click runs
on-click.doc: Command to execute when clicked on the module. A click also toggles the state (enable only if dynamic timeouts are enabled).
on-click.description: A command to run when you click the module. Empty keeps the normal behavior.

on-click-middle.label: Middle click runs
on-click-middle.doc: Command to execute when middle-clicked on the module using mousewheel. (reset the timeout to the initial value if dynamic timeouts are enabled).
on-click-middle.description: A command to run when you click the module with the mouse wheel.

on-click-right.label: Right click runs
on-click-right.doc: Command to execute when you right-click on the module. (deactivate the inhibit if dynamic timeouts are enabled).
on-click-right.description: A command to run when you right-click the module.

on-update.label: On every refresh run
on-update.doc: Command to execute when the module is updated.
on-update.description: A command to run each time the module updates.

on-scroll-up.label: Scroll up runs
on-scroll-up.doc: Command to execute when scrolling up on the module. (increase the timeout if dynamic timeouts are enabled).
on-scroll-up.description: A command to run when you scroll up over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

on-scroll-down.label: Scroll down runs
on-scroll-down.doc: Command to execute when scrolling down on the module. (decrease the timeout if dynamic timeouts are enabled).
on-scroll-down.description: A command to run when you scroll down over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

smooth-scrolling-threshold.label: Scroll sensitivity
smooth-scrolling-threshold.doc: Threshold to be used when scrolling.
smooth-scrolling-threshold.description: How far you must scroll on a touchpad before something happens. Higher means less sensitive.

start-activated.label: Start activated
start-activated.doc: Whether the inhibit should be activated when starting waybar.
start-activated.description: Whether the inhibit should be activated when starting waybar.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.doc: The number of minutes the inhibition should last.
timeout.description: The number of minutes the inhibition should last.

timeout-step.label: Timeout step
timeout-step.doc: The number of minutes to add or subtract when scrolling (when dynamic timeouts are enabled).
timeout-step.description: The number of minutes to add or subtract when scrolling (when dynamic timeouts are enabled).

dynamic-timeouts.label: Dynamic timeouts
dynamic-timeouts.doc: Option to enable dynamic timeouts. The legacy singular spelling dynamic-timeout is also accepted as an alias.
dynamic-timeouts.description: Option to enable dynamic timeouts. The legacy singular spelling dynamic-timeout is also accepted as an alias.

wait-for-activity.label: Wait for activity
wait-for-activity.doc: When enabled, the idle inhibitor remains active as long as there is keyboard or mouse activity on the bar. If there is no activity for the duration specified in timeout, the inhibitor will automatically toggle off. This option requires timeout to be set.
wait-for-activity.description: When enabled, the idle inhibitor remains active as long as there is keyboard or mouse activity on the bar. If there is no activity for the duration specified in timeout, the inhibitor will automatically toggle off. This option requires timeout to be set.

signal.label: Signal
signal.doc: The signal number used to toggle the idle inhibitor externally. The number is valid between 1 and N, where SIGRTMIN+N = SIGRTMAX. Use pkill -SIGRTMIN+N waybar to toggle the idle inhibitor from scripts or keybindings.
signal.description: The signal number used to toggle the idle inhibitor externally. The number is valid between 1 and N, where SIGRTMIN+N = SIGRTMAX. Use pkill -SIGRTMIN+N waybar to toggle the idle inhibitor from scripts or keybindings.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-format-activated.label: Tooltip when active
tooltip-format-activated.doc: This format is used when the inhibit is activated.
tooltip-format-activated.description: This format is used when the inhibit is activated.

tooltip-format-deactivated.label: Tooltip when inactive
tooltip-format-deactivated.doc: This format is used when the inhibit is deactivated.
tooltip-format-deactivated.description: This format is used when the inhibit is deactivated.

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.doc: Action that popups the menu. Cannot be "on-click".
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. There need to be an element of type GtkMenu with id menu
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: The actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.
